info.title: Zagens Runtime HTTP API
info.description: Local sidecar (`deepseek-runtime`) HTTP/SSE surface consumed by Zagens desktop web-ui. SSOT routes: `crates/tui/src/runtime_api/router.rs`.

BearerAuth.description: Runtime token from Zagens shell (`DEEPSEEK_RUNTIME_TOKEN` / Tauri proxy).

CoherenceState.description: User-facing coherence ladder for session health.

Usage.description: Token usage metadata for a response.

reasoning_replay_tokens.description:
Approximate input tokens spent re-sending prior `reasoning_content`
across user-message boundaries (V4 §5.1.1 "Interleaved Thinking").

SessionMetadata.description: Session metadata stored with each saved session

updated_at.description: When the session was last updated

message_count.description: Number of messages in the session

runtime_thread_id.description: Runtime thread store id for Zagens event replay (tools + thinking UI).

UpdateThreadRequest.title: UpdateThreadRequest
UpdateThreadRequest.description:
Mutable fields accepted by `PATCH /v1/threads/{id}`.

Each field is optional — missing means "no change". Extended in v0.8.10
(#562, whalescale#256) so the UI can flip persistent thread state without
having to recreate a thread or pass per-turn overrides on every send.

workspace.description:
When set, rebind tool workspace for this thread. Path must exist and be a
directory. Relative paths resolve against the runtime API default workspace.
Unloads cached engine entry when changed (disallowed while a turn is in progress).

TaskCounts.description: Count totals by status for task dashboards.
